Name: DT Fleet Assessor (read-only)
Description: Least-privilege role for `dt_appservice_fleet.py assess` AND `dt_appservice_sidecar.py assess` (dry runs). Read-only: lists App Services, reads site config + app settings, sitecontainers, slots, and the App Service Plan (SKU), and queries Resource Graph. Grants NO write or restart permission. Assign to the delegated user who runs assessments — no Service Principal or admin account required.
